conviction_note: Event is real and the history gap is a matcher miss: the Q2 2026 results 8-K of 2026-07-23 is itemised 2.01 rather than 2.02 on EDGAR, and that print (beat, FY guide raised) moved the stock +26.5% close to close (36.05 to 45.61), which the baseline's median of 2.86% leaves out. The print is the last standalone Gentherm quarter and the first chance to guide the combined company (Modine Performance Technologies closed 2026-10-01), so abs_move is set at 8% against a 2.86% baseline median. p_up is 57: the standalone trend and a low-looking single-source EPS bar lean up, the flowback after the close looks non-fundamental, and the PT business adds a shrinking segment to the outlook. Findings sum to +1.3 and the scaled number is +1.1, so the two measurements agree.
bar: Adjusted EPS of $0.64 for Q3 2026 (finviz 'EPS next Q', read 2026-10-21, https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=THRM). This is a single source, so every finding is capped small. For comparison: Q3 2025 adjusted EPS was $0.73 on $386.9M revenue (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/903129/000119312525247599/thrm-ex99_1.htm), and Q1/Q2 2026 were $0.84 and $0.75. No revenue consensus was found. The company guide (standalone, excluding Modine) is FY2026 product revenue of $1.55-1.65B and adjusted EBITDA of $185-200M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/903129/000119312526313204/thrm-ex99_1.htm). Against H1 actuals of $809.9M revenue and $98.1M EBITDA, that implies H2 revenue of $740-840M and H2 EBITDA of $87-102M.
positioning_check: Short float 4.00%, short ratio 2.07 days, float 53.28M, shares outstanding 54.48M (finviz, read 2026-10-21; settlement date not shown). Not a crowded short. The option chain is unusable: no two-sided ATM quotes, total OI 449, put/call OI 3.36 on that tiny base, so there is no skew to read. The sell-side has not followed the price: mean target $48.43 against spot $28.81, JPMorgan upgraded to Overweight ($48) on 2026-09-15, CJS initiated Outperform ($50) on 2026-09-14 (finviz). The tape shows a one-off holder turnover: 23,735,961 new shares went to Modine holders on 2026-10-01 and volume ran 6.1M / 5.3M / 10.6M on 10-02 / 10-05 / 10-06 against roughly 0.2-0.9M a day in September. The 20-day run-up of -18.3% includes a $2.07 special dividend (record 2026-09-28), so about 6 points of it are mechanical.

findings.finding: Standalone Gentherm grew product revenue 11.3% in Q1 2026 ($393.7M) and 11.0% in Q2 ($416.2M), with adjusted EPS of $0.84 and $0.75, and Q2 auto CCS outgrew S&P light-vehicle production by 14 points. Yet the raised FY guide ($1.55-1.65B revenue, $185-200M EBITDA) implies H2 revenue of $740-840M against $809.9M in H1, and the single-source Q3 EPS bar of $0.64 sits below last year's $0.73. A Q3 beat on the reported quarter is likely if H1 trends held through September.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat and raise: +26.5% close to close on 2026-07-23 (36.05 to 45.61, Yahoo daily bars). Q1 2026 beat ($0.84 against $0.51 a year earlier): +2.99% (baseline). Q3 2025: +8.18% (baseline). So this name has paid for beats.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected a strong standalone Q3, the EPS bar would sit at or above the $0.73 printed a year ago and the $0.75 of Q2, not at $0.64. The stock would also not trade 37% below its post-Q2 high, with targets at $48. The bar has one source and the shares may be pricing the combined company rather than this quarter, so this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 release (a different document, same company): revenue +11.3%, EBITDA margin up to 12.5% from 11.1%, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/903129/000119312526171740/thrm-ex99_1.htm. GM's Q3 North America wholesale (finding 4) is a separate proxy pointing the same way.

findings.finding: The outlook given with this print will be the first to include Modine Performance Technologies, about $1.13B of trailing sales against Gentherm's guided ~$1.6B. In its last reported quarter (ended 2026-06-30) that business shrank: net sales $277.8M, down 3% (organic -4%), adjusted EBITDA $36.2M, down 3%, gross margin down 60bp, on 'lower sales to automotive and commercial vehicle customers due to market weakness' and 'higher material and tariff costs'. A combined guide or Q4 bridge built on that trend risks a soft organic headline, partly offset by PT's 13.8% trailing EBITDA margin, which is above Gentherm's ~12%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior combined guide. On guide changes: the Q2 2026 raise drove the +26.5% day, and in Feb 2025 the initial FY guide went with -7.75% (baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Modine's release is public, but it was read by Modine holders and was never part of a Gentherm guide. Gentherm's FY guide explicitly 'does not reflect any impact from the planned combination'. If THRM holders had priced a shrinking PT, the sell-side's $48 target would have come down after the close; none of the targets has moved since mid-September. Net of the rest of the company: Gentherm's own ~60% of the combined revenue grew 11% in H1, so this finding is a drag on the mix, not a thesis on the whole.
findings.independence: Modine's recast segment history shows the PT EBITDA trend over five quarters: 14.7% margin in Sep-2025 against 13.0% in Jun-2026, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/67347/000110465926086644/mod-20260724xex99d1.htm. Same issuer, different document.

findings.finding: Holder turnover after the close: Gentherm issued 23,735,961 shares to Modine holders on 2026-10-01 (about 44% of the new 54.5M count). Volume then ran 6.1M, 5.3M and 10.6M shares on 10-02, 10-05 and 10-06, against 0.2-0.9M a day in September, and has since eased to 1.0-2.1M. The stock fell from 33.63 to 28.62 (-14.9%) between the closing day and 10-21. Over the same weeks auto-supplier peers barely moved: LEA ~122.7 to ~119 (about -3%), ADNT 17.31 to 17.36 (flat). That is about 12 points of idiosyncratic underperformance with a mechanical cause, so a reassuring first combined print has room to close part of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior instance for this name. The stock's only comparable dislocation, the Q2 pop to $45.61, unwound over August-September in line with auto-supplier peers (LEA and ADNT both about -17% from late July).
findings.why_not_priced: Selling by holders who received shares they did not choose is non-fundamental by construction. If the market had already looked through it, THRM would have tracked LEA and ADNT in October rather than lagging them by about 12 points, and the gap to the $48 mean target would not be 68%. The price path comes from Yahoo daily bars (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/THRM?range=3mo&interval=1d). Peer bars were read from Yahoo weekly charts.
findings.independence: Peer price series from a different source: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ADNT?range=3mo&interval=1wk and https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/LEA?range=3mo&interval=1wk. The share issuance and the volume share the same underlying event.

findings.finding: GM, a large North American customer for climate seats, reported Q3 2026 GMNA wholesale of 870k units against 840k a year earlier (+3.6%) on 2026-10-20, raised its adjusted automotive FCF guide to $11.5-12.5B (from $9.5-11.5B), and lifted GMNA EBIT-adjusted 43.4%. That is a counterparty read on North American production in the quarter Gentherm reports.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no measured THRM reaction to a GM read-through. Gentherm's own Q2 release credited outgrowing light-vehicle production by 14 points.
findings.why_not_priced: It came out after Gentherm last spoke and one session before the print, so the $0.64 bar predates it. This is a proxy: it is one OEM and one region, and Gentherm has not confirmed the transmission, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Quality-of-beat risk: Q2 2026 gross margin fell to 23.2% from 23.9% on 'higher material costs and higher warranty accruals', adjusted EBITDA margin slipped to 11.7% from 12.2% even as revenue rose 11%, and six-month operating cash flow was only $2.3M (restructuring and M&A spend). If those persisted into Q3, a revenue beat could come with a margin miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026 the same margin dip was looked through, and the stock rose 26.5% on the revenue beat and guide raise.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q2 headline was the beat-and-raise, and the warranty and material-cost line drew little reaction. If the market weighted it, the Q2 day would not have been +26%. This finding shares the Q2 release with finding 1 but rests on a different line (margin rather than revenue), and it points the other way.
findings.independence: Modine PT also cited 'higher material and tariff costs' for its June-quarter margin, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/67347/000110465926088230/mod-20260729xex99d1.htm.

baseline_tension: The baseline has no skew and its -18% run-up is about one-third a special dividend. What I found leans mildly against the drawdown (strong standalone trend, non-fundamental flowback), and sector weakness (LEA and ADNT -17% since July) explains the pre-close decline, so p_up is held at 57 rather than higher.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar has one source, finviz): reported-quarter finding 1 capped from +1.2 to +1.0.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; documents beat inference): flowback finding 3 kept because it has a documented mechanism (23.7M shares issued, volume spike), but cut from +1.5 to +1.0, since peers explain part of the decline and the non-fundamental read is an inference.

Lesson 9 (size a segment finding net of the rest): PT guidance drag cut from -0.8 to -0.6, because Gentherm's own ~60% of combined revenue grew 11% in H1 and PT's weakness was public in Modine's July release.
Lesson 5 (a proxy is filed small): GM read-through cut from +0.5 to +0.4.
Lesson 8 (understatement is the systematic error) plus the first combined guide: abs_move_pct raised from 7.0 to 8.0. p_up left at 57.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the term loan was checked against its stated use and left unfiled as a negative (see rejected_candidates); this changed no size.
Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): this name's own history shows beats being bought (+26.5% on Q2), so no extra cut.
